Explain with short text: Create collections, compare two favorites, and share your taste. Show realistic app preview with fictional media artwork and clearly labeled Sample list. Carefully crafted accessible typography and generous deliberate space. Show beginning of next feature section at bottom. Visual world: contemporary pulp paperback rack. Ivory #efe5cc paper background, deep navy #11254a text, red #c0342e controls, muted taxi-yellow accent. Very bold condensed expressive display title, compact plain sans product description. Wide display of five beautiful painted fictional media covers, upright dominant center cover, with clear category tabs and numbered ranked-list interface underneath. Cover rack feels contemporary and usable, no skeuomorphic wire rack and no novelty 3D controls. Features exposed before account invitation.
